capabilities: import HWP, HWPX, HWPML, PDF, DOCX, XLS and XLSX files as Markdown notes
export notes to HWPX, DOCX, self-contained HTML and PDF
generate Korean official documents from note properties and reusable HWPX templates
compare two document versions into a change-table note
fill HWPX forms from note properties without modifying the original
extras: Desktop-only and requires Obsidian 1.8.9 or newer; all conversion runs offline with the Kordoc engine bundled, and scanned PDFs are not OCRed. Optional CMDS Eagle image upload can send image bytes to a user-configured Cloudflare Worker with a session-only API key.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to read Korean HWP/HWPX office documents into notes or produce the HWPX, DOCX and PDF files that Korean institutions require.

relations.evidence: Kordoc 4.15.7 built in: imports, generates, validates, compares, and fills documents without external setup.
Extracted images can stay as Vault attachments, be sent to the active CMDS Eagle cloud provider
DOCX | Styled Word document | Pandoc + HanMark Word template
No pypandoc-hwpx HWPX workflow: old Python installation and executable-path setup are retired

summary: Converter that imports HWP, HWPX, PDF, DOCX and XLSX files as Markdown and exports notes to HWPX, DOCX, HTML or PDF, including Korean official documents.
